verdict.rationale: Self-hosting is a fair question for a cloud marketplace platform, but nothing in the evidence shows Vast.ai ships a deployable version of its marketplace or console to run on your own infrastructure. The 'Host GPUs and earn' program is a different capability: it lists your machines on Vast's hosted marketplace rather than letting you run the product yourself. The open-source CLI and SDK are clients of the hosted service, not the core product.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can self-host the core product
